summary.text: Drew Cranmer, a Libertarian Party candidate and data engineer and small-business founder from Wichita, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kansas's 4th Congressional District to Ron Estes.
He describes himself as not a career politician.

paragraphs.text: Cranmer describes himself as a data engineer, small-business founder, husband and father from Wichita. He says he has spent his career building data pipelines and software, and that he has investigated warrantless license plate surveillance in his community.
During the campaign, he ran on restoring Congress's constitutional war and spending powers and devolving policy to the states.
He received 2.4% of the vote to Ron Estes's 53.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
